  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to correct for overconfidence in upward moves.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility in early periods (e.g., first 5-7 days) when price is trending downward, as models tend to overreact.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 10% above recent 5-day average, reduce by 5-10% to avoid over-optimism.",
    "Correct for lag: if true outcome is significantly higher than forecast 3-5 days later, adjust next forecast downward by 2-5% to account for delayed reaction.",
    "After sharp spikes (forecast > 15% above prior peak), reduce forecast by 10-20% to avoid overshoot.",
    "When sentiment > 0.25, increase forecast sensitivity to recent price action, but cap upward adjustments at +5% to prevent overcorrection.",
    "In low volatility regimes (e.g., < 2% daily range), apply a smoothing filter to avoid erratic swings.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast for 3+ consecutive days, shift forecast toward historical mean or 15-day moving average."
  ]
}
